title: BXIndustry Vertical Settings
description: Schema for src/pages/<vertical>/settings.json and settings/<vertical>.json. Validates the envelope that is consistent across every vertical (theme values, title, images). The 'settings' object's content blocks (header, home_page, dashboard, footer, etc.) are intentionally left permissive because their shape is bespoke per vertical - see src/pages/AGENTS.md for details. '{{currentYear}}' and '{{lastYear}}' are valid placeholder tokens anywhere a string is expected; they are replaced server-side at render time.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, used for editor validation/autocomplete only. Not read by the app.

theme.description: Flat map of CSS values (colors, fonts, etc.) consumed by the vertical's branding.hbs, where each key is mapped to a --bxi-* CSS custom property. All values must be plain strings (e.g. '#A71E23', "'Noto Sans', sans-serif", or 'var(--bxi-primary-color)').

settings.description: Page content and metadata rendered by the vertical's index.hbs/dashboard.hbs.

title.description: Project name, displayed in <head><title> and used as the default PWA manifest name.

images.description: Local paths (served from public/<vertical>/) or full CDN URLs for key branding images. Set a value to '' to hide that image. Additional vertical-specific image keys (e.g. dashboard_logo) are allowed.
